answer: Seed each epoch's challenge from an unpredictable public beacon so answers can't be pre-grown like saffron harvested early. The prompt is a jade token nobody can read until the prior epoch closes, and the invite graph is a vine whose non-kin branches must attest before anything finalizes. A sybil farm can neither stockpile valid answers in advance nor self-certify them, because freshness and stranger-attestation both bind at response time.
